design: Very tall lean elderly municipal guard with pale sand-coloured spotted skin, long narrow exposed mandible face, prominent uneven brow, near-white thin dreadlocks extending to waist. Weathered dark sleeveless guard coat over narrow bronze linked chest scales, cream neck wrap, knee-length split tunic and sparse low greaves. Long narrow spear held upright at the side, two small evidence tubes attached to belt. Slightly bowed experienced stance but physically capable, calm expression.
